candidate.title: PAIR
candidate.scope: PAIR (peptide nucleic acid-assisted identification of RNA-binding protein), the middle row of the assigned Illumina schematic: selected RNA-site PNA design, CPP-mediated live-cell delivery, CPP release, photoactivated protein capture, magnetic-bead recovery and SDS-PAGE visualization. TIVA above and CLaP below are neighboring rows, not alternatives identified by this PAIR card. This is a schematic-level protein-isolation architecture, with no depicted sequencing-library preparation. Paper support is limited to the supplied Bell and Eberwine 2015 abstract and publication metadata, not inspected full text.
